capabilities: Convert links between WikiLink and Markdown formats
Rewrite link paths as relative, absolute, or shortest possible
Convert links in the active file or across the whole vault
Trigger conversions from the Markdown file context menu
extras: README explains commands, context menu, and settings but has no usage examples; contact email and website are given for support.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to bulk-convert existing links between link styles or rewrite their paths across the vault or a single file.
summary: Link format converter that scans vault notes and converts links between WikiLink and Markdown syntax with relative, absolute, or shortest paths.
